notes.title: Falling Plus 2.21 update released
notes.notes:
Falling Plus Steam/Unified 2.21 has been released as of 1/24/2019.

The following minor changes were made in this version:
- If the game is paused after losing a life, but before the next life begins (or Game Over), the game will now behave more like a user would expect.
- The game can no longer be paused after it ends.  This prevents some undesired behaviors.
- Fixed a visual bug in the Steam Leaderboards browser.
- The "yyrGames" company logo was not respecting the "zoom" and "y-position" display settings properly.  This has been fixed.
